+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Дамп узлов потока в читаемый вид (внутри репо, без /tmp)."""
+import json
+
+rows = []
+for line in open("04-Memory/idea-graph/nodes.jsonl", encoding="utf-8"):
+    line = line.strip()
+    if not line:
+        continue
+    try:
+        rows.append(json.loads(line))
+    except Exception:
+        pass
+
+groups = ("stream", "world", "quest", "proto", "tech", "mech", "organ", "event")
+rows = [r for r in rows if r.get("graph") in groups]
+rows.sort(key=lambda r: (str(r.get("graph")), str(r.get("id"))))
+
+with open("STREAM-DUMP.md", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+    for r in rows:
+        f.write("### %s\n" % r.get("id"))
+        f.write("- graph: %s | kind: %s | status: %s | resolution: %s\n"
+                % (r.get("graph"), r.get("kind"), r.get("status"), r.get("resolution", "-")))
+        f.write("- label: %s\n" % r.get("label"))
+        ess = (r.get("essence") or "").replace("\n", " ")
+        if ess:
+            f.write("- essence: %s\n" % ess)
+点在 = 0
+        f.write("\n")
+print("узлов в дампе:", len(rows))
